title: You Can Now Buy a 28-Gram, CNC-Machined Titanium Dynamo Taillight—If You’re One of 30 Buyers
content:
Berlin-based Allygn upgrades its EdelMü rear light from aluminum to high-polished titanium while keeping the same German-made Busch & Müller electronics inside.

Read the full article at You Can Now Buy a 28-Gram, CNC-Machined Titanium Dynamo Taillight—If You’re One of 30 Buyers on Velo.
author: Josh Ross
